module: Module 4: Order Execution, Modification & Bulk Routing
title: Partial Close of Master Order (50% Volume Reduction)
precondition: Master holds open 10.0 lots EURUSD; submits partial close for 5.0 lots.
steps: 1. Master executes partial close of 5.0 lots.
expected_result: Each of the 20 child tickets partially closed by exactly 50%; remaining volume = 5.0 lots across accounts; realized P&L booked.
actual_result: POST /v1/oms/{instance}/positions/{market_order_id}/reduce proportionally reduces open position volume by requested percentage.
